data.message: I opt in to 18 tons this month, not contingent on others. Fisher01–24: individually choose 18 even if others choose 10? State your exact intended catch and any conditions. Assuming k choose 18 and others 10, catch=250+8k, stock left=250−8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500−16k (25%). Switching adds $8,000 now if fulfilled, but costs 8 stock now and 16 in the low-recovery outcome. Intentions aren't binding; long-run gains aren't guaranteed. Fisher09/17/18/23, help recruit.
